name: Math_Benchmark_Difficulty
description: A benchmark dataset that catalogs math problems by difficulty to measure model performance across a spectrum of mathematical reasoning challenges. It is intended to evaluate accuracy on problem solving, ranging from straightforward exercises to more complex multi-step problems, and to provide difficulty labels to analyze model scaling and failure modes. Metrics focus on exact-answer correctness rather than partial credit.
reputation: A small community dataset on Hugging Face used for diagnostic analyses of math difficulty; limited mainstream adoption.
